blocks.text: Why a Chauffeur Makes Sense in Cypress
Three practical reasons, specific to this city.
blocks.html: Three practical reasons, specific to this city.

items: Cypress is a flat, spread-out suburban city with no nightlife core, so most groups drive to Anaheim, Buena Park or Long Beach afterward, which is exactly the after-dark transfer a chauffeured vehicle handles.
Race days at Katella Avenue generate heavy parking demand and slow traffic on SR 91, I-5 and SR 57 approaches.
Valley View Street and Ball Road corridors saturate around school events and ceremonies.
Long Beach Airport sits just across the city line, so private-aviation arrivals need a short chauffeured transfer.

blocks.text: We also quote Cypress to the hour rather than the trip. blocks.text: Choosing a Vehicle for a Cypress Night

Capacity is the first filter, then cost per person. A stretch limo seats 6 to 8, a Chrysler 300 about 8, a Hummer 12, and a Sprinter limo up to 14. Our party bus seats 24. Below about ten people, two cars or a limo usually beats a bus. Above ten, the bus wins on cost per head and nobody gets left behind.
